_meta.note: 27 UFs (OSM admin_level 4; code = IBGE UF code) and IBGE's 5571 municipalities (admin_level 8; code = IBGE 7-digit code). Distrito Federal: IBGE counts the whole DF as one municipality, Brasília (5300108), while OSM has no Brasília relation and maps the DF's 35 regiões administrativas at admin_level 8 (as the OSM wiki documents). So Brasília is an alias of the Distrito Federal item, and the 35 regions are its level-8 children (code = OSM's IBGE:GEOCODIGO, an IBGE subdistrict code); this keeps board.py children from adding a 36th candidate that overlaps all the others, and from dropping regions that share a name with a municipality elsewhere (Planaltina, Santa Maria, Sobradinho, São Sebastião, Taguatinga, …). Names follow OSM's name tag, matched on IBGE:GEOCODIGO; the 36 municipalities IBGE spells differently (D'Oeste vs d'Oeste, Assú vs Assu, Januário Cicco vs Boa Saúde, …) keep the IBGE spelling as an alias. Other aliases: OSM's alt_name and old_name (Erexim, Santa Isabel do Pará, Santana do Livramento, and the DF regions' 'Região Administrativa' numerals), four documented former names (Fortaleza do Tabocão, Barão de Monte Alto, Ererê, and Curituba for Canindé de São Francisco, in place of OSM's misspelt old_name Curitiba), a typographic apostrophe (’) where a name has an ASCII one, hyphens as spaces, Tupi compounds hyphenated (Mogi-Mirim), and every name and alias without accents (Sao Paulo, Brasilia); the UFs add their abbreviation. 2799 aliases in all (2758 on level 8). The accent-free aliases serve cores whose admin lookup compares names exactly (there, letter case also has to match). 30 aliases are also the exact name of another municipality (Marau: Maraú's accent-free form and a municipality in Rio Grande do Sul; Caxias: Caxias do Sul's former name and a municipality in Maranhão); a lookup finds both only in cores that match exact aliases next to exact names. States come before municipalities, so the 8 municipalities named like a state (Amapá, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Mato Grosso, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Tocantins) resolve to the state first. OSM admin_level 3 holds the five macro-regions and level 6 only metropolitan regions; neither is in this table.
